query: What patient needs appear in visit notes?

per_column.name: visit_purpose_category
per_column.rationale: The category of purpose (acute complaint, chronic management, prevention) is an aspect of what the patient needs from the visit -- a constitutive facet of the need.

per_column.name: clinical_problem_type
per_column.rationale: The clinical problem domain (cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, etc.) captures the substantive 'what is needed help with' facet -- the medical content of the need.

per_column.name: acuity_complexity_level
per_column.rationale: Acuity/complexity is the severity/intensity aspect of the need, a legitimate constitutive dimension of how much and what kind of attention is required.

per_column.name: care_continuity_stage
per_column.rationale: Whether the need is a new problem vs ongoing follow-up vs surveillance is the temporal/continuity aspect of the need.

per_column.name: intervention_need_type
per_column.rationale: The type of intervention needed (procedure, medication, observation) is a direct constitutive part of the patient's need -- what care action is required.

per_column.name: specialist_referral_need
per_column.rationale: Referral need is a specific care-coordination facet of the patient's need; it is a part-of the need bundle, not an external predictor.

per_column.name: diagnostic_workup_need
per_column.rationale: The diagnostic workup required (imaging, labs) is a constitutive facet of the need -- what investigation the patient requires.

per_column.name: preventive_or_screening_need
per_column.rationale: Preventive/screening need is a distinct facet of patient needs, capturing the prevention-oriented component of care required.

judge.rationale: All eight columns are genuine part-of aspects of 'patient_needs' rather than external predictors, causes, or restatements, so each qualifies as a constitutive facet. Exhaustiveness is high: the set covers purpose, clinical domain, acuity, continuity stage, intervention, referral, diagnostics, and prevention -- most main constitutive dimensions of what a patient needs (a psychosocial/education need facet is a modest gap). Mutual exclusivity is only moderate: several facets overlap conceptually. 'visit_purpose_category' (e.g., preventive_wellness, medication_management, post_procedure_followup) substantially re-encodes distinctions captured by 'preventive_or_screening_need', 'intervention_need_type', and 'care_continuity_stage'. Likewise 'intervention_need_type' and 'specialist_referral_need'/'diagnostic_workup_need' all describe the care-action dimension and partially co-vary. These overlaps mean the facets do not cleanly carve the concept into non-overlapping aspects, lowering the ME score.
